CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: 1. Woman is a person who is female in gender.
2. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
3. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their child(ren), or father and his child(ren), or mother and her child(ren), or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
4. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
5. Violence against Women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
6. Violence against Children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, exploitation, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of freedom, and other violence.
7. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
8. Child Victim of Violence is a child who experiences violence and a child in conflict with the law.
9. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
10. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
11. Special Protection is protection given to children in emergency situations, children in conflict with the law, children from minority and isolated groups, children who are exploited economically and/or sexually, children who are trafficked, children who are victims of narcotics, alcohol, psychotropic, and other addictive substance (napza) abuse, children victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, children victims of violence both physical and/or mental, children with disabilities, and children victims of mistreatment and neglect.
12. Community is individuals, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
13. Social Rehabilitation is services aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
14. Service is immediate activities and actions taken to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or completed occurrence of violence against women and children carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
15. Counseling for Victims is the provision of assistance by an expert or trained person in such a way as to increase psychological understanding and ability in solving problems faced.
16. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and or spiritual guidance, for the self-strengthening of victims of violence to resolve the problems faced.
17. Technical Implementation Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is a technical implementation unit of the agency established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
18. Technical Implementation Unit of the Women and Child Protection Agency hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a technical implementation unit of the agency established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
19. Forum for Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and established at the regency, Kapanewon/sub-district, and Kalurahan/village levels.
20. Safe House is a temporary residence or shelter for victims, provided to give protection during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers of perpetrators.
21. Government Agency is a collective term covering work units/organizational units of ministries/departments, Non-Departmental Government Institutions, secretariats of state high institutions, and other government agencies, both central and regional, including State-Owned Enterprises, State-Owned Legal Entities, and Business Entities.
22. Region is Gunungkidul Regency. 8
23. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
24. Regent is the Regent of Gunungkidul.
25. Office of Women's Empowerment, Child Protection, and Family Planning, Community and Village Empowerment of Gunungkidul Regency hereinafter referred to as the Office, is the implementing element of government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: 1. Woman is a person who is female in gender.
2. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
3. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their child(ren), or father and his child(ren), or mother and her child(ren), or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
4. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
5. Violence against Women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
6. Violence against Children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, exploitation, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of freedom, and other violence.
7. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
8. Child Victim of Violence is a child who experiences violence and a child in conflict with the law.
9. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
10. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
11. Special Protection is protection given to children in emergency situations, children in conflict with the law, children from minority and isolated groups, children who are exploited economically and/or sexually, children who are trafficked, children who are victims of narcotics, alcohol, psychotropic, and other addictive substance (napza) abuse, children victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, children victims of violence both physical and/or mental, children with disabilities, and children victims of mistreatment and neglect.
12. Community is individuals, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
13. Social Rehabilitation is services aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
14. Service is immediate activities and actions taken to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or completed occurrence of violence against women and children carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
15. Counseling for Victims is the provision of assistance by an expert or trained person in such a way as to increase psychological understanding and ability in solving problems faced.
16. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and or spiritual guidance, for the self-strengthening of victims of violence to resolve the problems faced.
17. Technical Implementation Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is a technical implementation unit of the agency established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
18. Technical Implementation Unit of the Women and Child Protection Agency hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a technical implementation unit of the agency established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
19. 20. Safe House is a temporary residence or shelter for victims, provided to give protection during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers of perpetrators.
21. Government Agency is a collective term covering work units/organizational units of ministries/departments, Non-Departmental Government Institutions, secretariats of state high institutions, and other government agencies, both central and regional, including State-Owned Enterprises, State-Owned Legal Entities, and Business Entities.
22. Region is Gunungkidul Regency. 8
23. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
24. Regent is the Regent of Gunungkidul.
25. Office of Women's Empowerment, Child Protection, and Family Planning, Community and Village Empowerment of Gunungkidul Regency hereinafter referred to as the Office, is the implementing element of government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

Article 11
Other violence as referred to in Article 5 letter f namely:
a. threat of violence includes any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, image, symbol, or body movement, whether with or without using means that causes fear or restricts a person's fundamental freedom; and
b. coercion, includes a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something that is contrary to their own will.
